theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_ip_pt_frame_orthonormal
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (τ : Fin m → Eucl P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → Orthonormal ℝ (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 : Eucl (P + 1)) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ (τ i)))) : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl (P + 1))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
